name: Bed demand forecasting
objective: Forecast inpatient bed demand to guide capacity planning.
review: capacity office reviews forecasts before staffing changes

name: Bed availability forecasting
objective: Predict available bed count to reduce ED boarding and waitlist delays.
review: bed management confirms before divert decisions

name: Expected discharge prediction
objective: Predict whether an inpatient will discharge within the next N hours.
review: care managers review high-impact discharge lists

name: Length-of-stay prediction
objective: Estimate remaining and total LOS to improve discharge planning.
review: unit leadership reviews outliers >p95 predicted LOS

name: Patient deterioration risk
objective: Identify inpatients at elevated risk of clinical deterioration.
review: clinician review required before escalation pathway

name: Readmission risk
objective: Predict 30-day unplanned readmission risk at discharge.
review: care management reviews high-risk cohort daily

name: Mortality risk
objective: Estimate inpatient mortality risk for early intervention.

name: ICU transfer risk
objective: Predict likelihood of transfer to ICU within 24 hours.

name: Sepsis early warning
objective: Provide early warning for sepsis onset.

name: Emergency volume forecasting
objective: Forecast ED arrivals for staffing and surge planning.
review: ED operations reviews daily forecast pack

name: ED waiting-time prediction
objective: Predict door-to-provider or door-to-triage waiting time.
review: charge nurse uses as decision support only

name: Boarding-risk prediction
objective: Predict which ED visits will experience boarding.
horizon: from triage time through ED disposition

name: No-show prediction
objective: Predict appointment no-shows to improve schedule utilization.

name: Appointment demand forecasting
objective: Forecast appointment demand by specialty/provider pool.

name: Surgery cancellation risk
objective: Predict surgery cancellation risk before scheduled start.

name: Operating-room utilization optimization
objective: Recommend schedule patterns that improve OR utilization without raising cancellations.

name: Laboratory TAT breach prediction
objective: Predict which lab orders will breach TAT thresholds.

name: Critical laboratory result detection
objective: Prioritize likely critical/abnormal lab results for faster review.

name: Radiology TAT breach prediction
objective: Predict radiology orders at risk of TAT breach.

name: Medication safety risk
objective: Predict medication safety events before administration harm.

name: Drug interaction risk
objective: Detect likely clinically significant drug interactions.

name: Pharmacy demand forecasting
objective: Forecast medication dispense demand for inventory planning.

name: Claim denial prediction
objective: Predict claim denial risk before or at submission.
horizon: from claim creation to payer decision
review: RCM coding leads review high-risk claims

name: Payment-delay prediction
objective: Predict delayed payment beyond policy days.

name: Revenue forecasting
objective: Forecast expected collections/revenue for cash planning.
review: CFO office reviews monthly forecast pack

name: Fraud/waste/anomaly detection
objective: Detect anomalous billing or utilization patterns suggestive of waste/fraud.
review: compliance investigators must review all alerts

name: Staffing-demand forecasting
objective: Forecast staffing demand by role and department.

name: Absenteeism risk
objective: Predict staff absenteeism risk for upcoming shifts.
review: workforce managers review; no automated discipline

name: Workforce scheduling optimization
objective: Optimize shift assignments against demand and constraints.
review: staffing office must approve published schedules

name: Patient-flow optimization
objective: Optimize flow from ED to inpatient beds to reduce boarding and LOS.
review: command center review for diversion decisions

name: Hospital capacity forecasting
objective: Forecast overall hospital capacity pressure.

name: Supply utilization forecasting
objective: Forecast supply utilization to prevent stockouts.

name: Data-quality anomaly detection
objective: Detect DQ anomalies in volumes, null rates, and chronology.
review: data platform on-call reviews critical anomalies

name: Pipeline failure prediction
objective: Predict pipeline run failures before SLA breach.
horizon: from run start through completion window

name: Metric anomaly detection
objective: Detect anomalous KPI movements for executive attention.
review: analytics owner validates before executive push

name: Executive narrative insights
objective: Generate evidence-backed narrative insights from KPI movements (no freeform hallucination).
review: executive analytics editor reviews before distribution

name: Root-cause analysis recommendations
objective: Recommend likely root-cause drivers for KPI anomalies.
review: domain analyst confirms before executive action
